name: folio
description: Personal portfolio manager: track holdings across brokers and currencies, see real performance, keep your allocation on target.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @folio/shared && npm run build -w @folio/core
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,core,api,market,web -c gray,yellow,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @folio/shared" "npm run dev -w @folio/core" "npm run dev -w @folio/api" "npm run dev:market" "npm run dev -w @folio/web"
